capabilities_done: (1) components::smart_animate: match_layers pairs two frame snapshots by name path (ancestor names up to the top-level frame, same depth, index among same-named siblings); implicit (autoRename) text layers match by text style with the nearest x/y; interpolate tweens position, size, rotation (shortest arc), opacity, RGBA fill and corner radius at the eased progress (back-easing overshoot extrapolates geometry, clamps opacity/colour, size/radius >= 0); smart_animate_frame draws source-only layers beneath dissolving out, destination-only dissolving in (outermost unmatched layer only), matched layers with changed content cross-dissolved in place; ActiveTransition.match_layers set for SMART_ANIMATE and directional match_layers; bounded (MAX_SMART_LAYERS, MAX_SMART_DEPTH), typed refusals for dangling parent, cycle, duplicate id, non-finite props

(2) Folio StudioDesignRecords.frame_overlay: StudioFrameOverlay {node, overlay_position_type (8 values, absent = unset = CENTER), overlay_background NONE | SOLID_COLOR{StudioRgba}, overlay_background_interaction NONE | CLOSE_ON_CLICK_OUTSIDE}, serde-default + skipped when empty (byte-identical, test prototype_records_contract::overlay_records_round_trip_and_keep_empty_sets_identical); validation refuses dangling/duplicate entries, bad colours and STU-PRO-154 (OVERLAY to a MANUAL frame without overlay_relative_position). interop-fig decodes overlayPositionType, overlayBackgroundAppearance, overlayBackgroundInteraction, node/action overlayRelativePosition and text autoRename (were field_not_decoded losses) and maps them (precision 2; unknown tokens, missing MANUAL position (origin used) and a position on a non-overlay navigation are typed losses). components player: overlay_positions per open overlay, overlay_config, overlay_placement (8 positions + MANUAL), click_outside_overlay (CLOSE_ON_CLICK_OUTSIDE)

notes.figma_reading: Figma help center (read 2026-10-15): 360039818874 'Smart animate layers between frames' (matching uses the layer name and where it sits in the hierarchy; animates position, scale, opacity, rotation, fill; new layers dissolve into view) and 21523793229463 'Identify matching objects' (same layer name; implicitly named text layers match by text style, best match by x and y; all ancestor frames must have matching names, top-level frame names need not; same position in the hierarchy; duplicate names use the index within the parent). Corner radius tweening is a lane requirement, not stated by Figma's page. Figma parity of all of it UNVERIFIED (D5).
